title: [Bug] ! CRITICAL ! Input Unresponsive on Windows After v1.0.113
body:
**Bug Description**
Critical bug. Any version above Claude Code 1.0.113 is not usable on my windows machine. I run claude and then I can't type anything in the input, can't even exit it with CTRL+C, no input gets registered at all it seems. The screen is not frozen cause I do still see the "IDE connected or disconnected" but input is not getting registered. I tried every version going backwards, and notice that at version 1.0.113 I can enter input again. 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: win32
- Terminal: windows-terminal
- Version: 1.0.113
- Feedback ID: 8cd71673-fc63-44db-b463-ddaaaf8fe695

**Errors**
